name: listEach
description: call the given UDF/Closure with every value in the string list.
syntax: listEach( string list, function closure, [string delimiter], [boolean includeEmptyFields], [boolean multiCharacterDelimiter], [boolean parallel], [number maxThreads] )

params.name: closure
params.description:
function/closure that implements the following constructor

`function(element, index, list){}`

params.name: delimiter
params.description: delimiter used to separate the string list

params.name: multiCharacterDelimiter
params.description:
specify whether the delimiters parameter is a multi-character delimiter.

If this parameter is true, the delimiters parameter must specify a single delimiter consisting of multiple characters.

This parameter enables the [[function-ListToArray]] function to convert a list such as the following to an array of color names: red:|orange:|yellow:|green:|blue:|indigo:|violet.

params.name: maxThreads
params.description: maximum number of threads executed, ignored when argument "parallel" is set to false
